integrity: Standalone analytical proof and two-state-size exhaustive finite checker included; self-review only.
scientific_limitations: Variance exponents are bounded between one third and two thirds, but neither bound is asserted sharp. The asymptotic one-color constant is from Gravner and Kulhanek; finite exhaustive checks do not prove universal theorems. General negative association is prior mathematics. Historical priority and specialist validation remain open.
title: Two-sided fluctuation bounds for acyclic color classes in critical random digraphs
